scenes.description: Mist clings to cracked platform tiles. A rusted departure board flickers, stuck on a train that never came. ARJUN (30s, weathered jacket, a duffel bag slung over one shoulder) stands alone at the edge of the platform, staring down the empty track. A single crow lands on the signal post. Arjun doesn't flinch. He checks a folded photograph, then tucks it back into his jacket. He sits on an overturned crate, pulls his collar up against the cold, and waits.

dialogue.text: Still here. Still waiting. That has to count for something.

scenes.description: A one-room flat above the station, walls yellowed with age. Newspaper clippings are pinned above a narrow bed. MAYA (late 20s, sharp-eyed, sleeves rolled up) packs a small bag with quick, practiced movements. A kettle whistles on a two-burner stove. She ignores it. A knock at the door. She freezes, hand hovering over the bag's zipper. She exhales, grabs the bag, and crosses to the door.

dialogue.text: If he's really down there, I'm not waiting for the next train.
Maya. It's open. I know you're in there.

scenes.description: Stalls packed shoulder to shoulder, awnings in faded reds and yellows. Vendors shout over one another. Maya weaves through the crowd, scanning faces. Arjun trails a few paces behind, struggling to keep pace. They stop at a spice vendor's stall. An OLD WOMAN behind the counter studies them both for a long moment before speaking.

dialogue.text: Keep up or get left behind. Same as always.
You're looking for the warehouse. Everyone who looks like you two is.

scenes.description: Moonlight cuts through broken skylights onto stacked crates and rusted machinery. Arjun's flashlight sweeps the dark. Maya moves silently beside him, a crowbar in hand. Somewhere deeper in the warehouse, metal scrapes against concrete. A shape moves between the crates. Maya raises the crowbar. Silence. Nothing answers. The flashlight beam finds only an empty crate, lid ajar.

dialogue.text: Whoever you are, this is your only warning.

scenes.description: A cliffside road overlooking the sea, the sky burning orange over the water. Arjun and Maya walk side by side, the warehouse and the city now far behind them. The duffel bag sits heavier on Arjun's shoulder. They keep walking as the sun drops toward the horizon. FADE OUT.

dialogue.text: You never told me what was actually in that bag.
Answers. Or what's left of them.
